findings.explanation: ArchiveStore is named only by server code (the exports service and its fs adapter) — nothing under client/ or reviewer-core/ references it. vendor/shared is the hand-synced surface mirrored into other packages; per the skill's port-placement rule, a server-only port belongs beside its adapter (the Tokenizer precedent, followed correctly here by Clock in adapters/clock/index.ts), not in the shared contracts package.
findings.fix: Move the ArchiveStore interface out of vendor/shared/adapters.ts into server/src/adapters/archive/index.ts, exported alongside FsArchiveStore, and import it from there in the container.

findings.rule: Adapter constructed inside the application layer (compose only at the root; external I/O via container ports)
findings.explanation: ExportsService imports the concrete FsArchiveStore from adapters/ and news it up inline, so the application ring is hard-wired to one infrastructure implementation and the archive cannot be swapped via ContainerOverrides in tests. The dependency table forbids a service importing adapter concretes; only platform/container.ts may know them — note the container currently wires no ArchiveStore at all.
findings.fix: Inject the ArchiveStore port into ExportsService (constructor parameter, like Clock), construct FsArchiveStore in platform/container.ts, and add an archive?: ArchiveStore slot to ContainerOverrides.

findings.rule: Config and secret read from process.env in the application layer, bypassing AppConfig and the SecretsProvider port
findings.explanation: The service reads ARCHIVE_DIR and EXPORT_SIGNING_SECRET directly from process.env. Configuration resolution belongs to the composition root (loadConfig/AppConfig), and secrets must be reached only through the SecretsProvider port — every other adapter in the container receives this.secrets, while this signing secret (with a hardcoded 'dev-secret' fallback) escapes that path entirely.
findings.fix: Resolve the archive directory from AppConfig and the signing secret via the SecretsProvider inside platform/container.ts when constructing FsArchiveStore; the service never touches process.env.
